summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or installing anything, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL format entry and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(), which returns True only when is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not verified by running: the test suite and Black. The console test is gated on sys.platform == "win32" rather than legacy_windows=False; adjust if you meant the latter. Nothing committed.
